notes.title: Halloween Update - Spooky skins, bat wings, tricks and treats!
notes.notes:
Hello babies, daddies and Zombies 

This month's spooooky update has just been released 🎃!. Tryout the new Halloween themed skins and hat, bat wings, bones, trick or treat bags and much more!

[previewyoutube=H952Xz-NU9w;full][/previewyoutube]

Read the full Patch notes here:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11272318/cb374841c37ca6ef69950b36a27d32f657b71443.png

ZomBaby
- Zombaby is effected differently by items! Sickness heals the Zombaby over time. Items that typically restore health hurt it, and items that usually decrease health, restore it! The Zombaby is a difficult and frustrating child to parent.
- The model designer felt uncomfortable modeling & texturing actual baby flesh, so we opted to make this baby’s flesh with raw steak “guts” and a raw chicken breast “brain”, dyed pink for the necessary color pop.
NecroDaddy
- Spawns with a healing staff. This magical rod allows Daddy to keep babies and daddies healthy! It even works on the Zombaby!
Pumpkin Hat
- Blocks headshots until it breaks
- Eat pumpkin pieces to wear the pumpkin. Players who do not eat pumpkin pieces are not permitted to wear the pumpkin hat.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11272318/be002fb95fc5f713a111ce99bc94c8023f797b54.png

Trick or Treat Bags
- Is it a trick? or treat? Break open to find out!
Return of the Halloween Decorations!
- Also added some more pumpkins
- And bones! Whose bones are these?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11272318/63ccb0c8cd5f23e5cac69bbf9257bd577378af51.png

Games now default to nighttime - very spooky
- At nighttime, the bear is now made of bones, instead of traditional flesh, for the holiday.
- A bat is in the backyard! What to do with it?
Daddy’s Nightmare Updates
- Daddy Health bars now show on baby screens and other Daddy’s
- Babies can now die & respawn in daddy’s nightmare
Item Reworks
- Bats, Hammers & Crow bars: These items now have an extra powerful charge swing ability!
- Ball Blaster: Can now lock on to characters with the “Throw” button (Default Right Click/Left Trigger)
Mechanic Changes
- Throwing can now be charged to increase the power of your throw
- Reaching 100 sickness will now cause a player to vomit. Vomiting removes sickness and deals a small amount of health damage.
- Daddies can now die and respawn
- Daddy bodies can be picked up, thrown, and eaten (the choice is yours)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11272318/5d3f0d50b97cdbd8fbea643c598ab061c7a616dd.png

Baby Disably can now disconnect if the link is broken.
Sickness ticks every frame for drinks

Fudge the Bulldog is wearing festive headgear

Energy is now used slower when running & jumping, but also recharges slower
10 energy loss for feeding a healthy item and 30 energy loss for feeding an unhealthy item (the logic here is that it take a lot less energy to feed a baby some fruit, than to feed a baby a handheld vacuum)

 Now restores 100 energy on consumption

Debuff now lasts 30 seconds (previously 10)

Now lasts 60 seconds(previously 30).

We understand that many players are expecting more rooms in this release. We currently do not have a release date set for the remaining rooms because we want to take some more time to focus on quality improvement for the preexisting areas. notes.title: Who's Your Daddy?! Remake: Status Update

Hi Everyone!

We are extremely excited to showcase all the new features and content included in this new updated version of Who’s Your Daddy?! We believe that this update will take the game to a whole new level of quality while still maintaining that quirky vibe that players have come to enjoy! This isn’t just a remaster, we’ve redone EVERYTHING.

We have been having alot of fun designing new content for this update, but we have also been working very hard to deliver it into your hands! The release coming at the end of the year will feature exclusively The Kitchen and The Living Room, similar to the OG Alpha that was released 5 years ago to date. These rooms feature a complete experience of what to expect from Who's Your Daddy, with many new surprises! This new release WILL NOT delete or overwrite the current version of Who’s Your Daddy. We simply need more time to create content that holds up to the standards of quality gameplay that our players deserve! Every individual room should be able to offer complete, unadulterated gameplay, therefore, the focus for future updates will be on new rooms, new interactions, and fixing bugs. 

On a personal note, I feel extremely honored to be working with the most amazing team and dedicating my career to making this game the best it can be. notes.title: New Game Mode - Daddy's Nightmare is here!! Version 1.7.5
notes.notes:
Daddy's Nightmare is ready for download!

A new game mode has made its way to Who's Your Daddy! This new mode, Daddy's Nightmare, features a dark, spooky version of the family home where the dad must get the power turned back on by filling the generator with gasoline, or by hiding and surviving from the deadly little creatures taking claim of his hard-earned home.

This update also includes the following changes:
Hungry Games- Items now spawn at "GO!" instead of in the middle of the countdown
Pets now spawn in splitscreen
Daddy can no longer "prone-phase" through walls while going backwards


Josh and I will be on vacation this week, the next update will not be until 8/19/16.

Have fun!
Joe

notes.title: V1.1.0 - Graphics Optimizations - What to expect for official release?
notes.notes:
V1.1.0 is Ready for Download!

The most significant change in this update is increased frame rates cause by improved meshes and several new graphics options including:

Low Quality Textures
Limited View Distance
Low Quality Render Engine


Several other features/fixes come with this update as well:
When playing Family Gathering with the "All Babies Must Die" option, babies can now spectate after dying
Set To Default buttons have been added to all the main menu options
Split Screen UI has been restored
And more to be found in the detailed patch notes

Detailed Patch Notes

What to expect for the official release on April 29th

With the official release coming soon, I'd like to fill everyone in what to expect by this date. You can be prepared to see the following core new features by this date:
Explorable outside mode with new dangers and chores
22 Achievements to be earned, with an unlockable wearable connected to each one
Increased customization for custom games, options such as turning off specific items, changing round time, and additional win conditions
Various Leaderboards to compete in
And more to be revealed!


The purpose of this release date is to signify the completion of the product which I had originally intended to end up with. However, due to the games extraordinary success, development will be continuing far beyond this point and you can still expect weekly updates for many months to come! Features such as more game modes, new maps, new items, and new characters will be coming at no additional costs to all players!

notes.title: V0.9.5 New item, Big Optimizations Done. Family Gathering and Official Release Date Delayed
notes.notes:
V0.9.5 Update - Baby Gate, Optimization. Delay Announcement

Main Changes for V0.9.5
New Item - Baby Gate: Can be placed anywhere to block babies movement for a minimum of 20 seconds. Baby can punch it multiple times to break it.
Multiplayer Changes: Added a "Find a Daddy" and "Find a Baby" options. Make's it easier to join a queue to play your desired character without swapping
Heavy Optimizations Done: Occlusion Culling, can cause up to a 50% performance boost
Added a menu option to mute the baby's screams
Many bug fixes which can be read in the detailed patch notes


Detailed Patch Notes

Family Gathering and Official Release Delayed
     Family Gathering is still too deep in the testing phase to be made public at this point. I chose to focus on increasing performance this week, this is the cause for delay. You can expect it to come with next week's update ready to go!

     After some careful consideration, I have also chosen to delay the official release of the game. The games official release date will now be April 29th, and the Beta will begin on March 31st.

      I made this decision being well aware that I would not be able to add in the remaining content I have planned before the initial date(Such as game modes, an outside area, and character customization). I did not want to give the impression that I was pushing what is currently an incomplete game as ready for an official release.
